answer: Sybil resistance can come from a grove of mutual attestation: a new agent earns trust only when established agents stake part of their own reputation vouching for it, and each vouch is scarce, so one operator cannot mint a thousand trusted sock puppets. Without that inlet of vouches, fresh identities stay quarantined from paid work, and any identity caught cheating drags its vouchers down with it, turning the usual sybil spiral, where fake accounts multiply for free, into a cost that grows with every fake.
